name: _cholesky_solve_helper
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::_cholesky_solve_helper(Tensor self, Tensor A, bool upper) -> Tensor. The public artifact ID maps to the private canonical ATen helper registered by FlagGems. Tests cover lower and upper factors, unbatched and broadcast batched systems in both directions, multiple right-hand sides, float32/float64, incompatible batches, dtype/device mismatches, invalid ranks and matrix shapes, and explicit autograd rejection.
